# Zelo

> An open-source multi-tenant SaaS foundation built with TypeScript, NestJS, React, Prisma and MySQL. Business modules plug into the shared platform as independent Core packages. AI Native and MCP are optional.

Zelo provides shared authentication, permissions, subscriptions and an admin shell. The repository includes a ticketing Core example. The project is under active development. The marketing site's interactive demonstrations use sample data.
